title: Coinbase Global Inc.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Coinbase is the compliance-first crypto exchange: the only regulated venue where institutions, ETF custodians, and retail coexist. As Bitcoin ETF AUM grows past $50B, Coinbase earns custody fees on every dollar. Transaction fee volatility is offset by growing subscription and services revenue (staking, USDC yield, Base L2 activity).

Key Drivers

  • ETF Custody Moat: Custodian for BlackRock, Fidelity, and Invesco Bitcoin ETFs: fee income grows with AUM.
  • Base L2: Their Ethereum L2 chain processes millions of transactions: a platform business on top of an exchange.
  • Staking Revenue: Coinbase earns ~25% of staking rewards it processes: now a multi-hundred-million dollar annual stream.

Risk Factors

  • Revenue Volatility: Transaction revenue collapses in bear markets.
  • Regulatory Overhang: SEC enforcement, though reduced under pro-crypto administration, can resurface.

Future Tech Roadmap

DeFi Decentralized Finance Ecosystem Confirmed Ongoing
On-chain lending, trading, derivatives without intermediaries: $100B+ TVL
📈 Coinbase benefits from DeFi activity through Base (its L2 chain), exchange volume on ETH and DeFi tokens, and potential future integration of DeFi products into its institutional custody business.
MONOPOLY · 80% no direct rivals identified
Bitcoin Proof-of-Work Blockchain Confirmed Ongoing
First decentralized permissionless monetary ledger; 15+ years continuous uptime
📈 Marathon is a Bitcoin miner. Revenue is direct function of Bitcoin price and network hashrate. Margin depends on energy cost per hash. This is a leveraged Bitcoin position with operational execution risk.
⚡ 2ND · 88% behind MSTR 95% (−6pp)
MONOPOLY no direct rivals identified
